# Error Codes

A failure carries an uppercase code, from `src/prometheus_exporter/errors.uc`, and a detail. It is written `CODE (detail)`, or `CODE` alone without one: in the log (`collector '<name>': CODE (detail)`, see [Log messages](log-messages.md)), in `check`, in the ubus object's replies and on LuCI's status page. A collector that fails has `node_scrape_collector_success` 0.

## Collectors and their sources

| Code | Meaning | Raised by |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `SOURCE_UNREADABLE` | A file the collector reads is not there or cannot be read. The detail names it. | the collectors `bmx7`, `conntrack`, `cpu`, `dhcp_leases`, `diskstats`, `entropy`, `exporter`, `filefd`, `interrupts`, `loadavg`, `meminfo`, `nat_traffic`, `netstat`, `pressure`, `selinux`, `snmp6`, `sockstat`, `softnet`, `timesync`, `uci_dhcp_host`, `uname`, `vmstat` |
| `SOURCE_INVALID` | What the collector read is not what it expects: a file, a ubus reply or a program's output it cannot parse. The detail says where. | `services.uc`; the collectors `bmx7`, `chrony`, `conntrack`, `cpu`, `dawn`, `dhcp_leases`, `diskstats`, `dnsmasq`, `entropy`, `filefd`, `filesystem`, `hostapd_stations`, `interrupts`, `loadavg`, `ltq-dsl`, `meminfo`, `modemmanager`, `mwan3`, `netclass`, `netdev`, `netstat`, `nft-counters`, `openwrt`, `openwrt_interfaces`, `pressure`, `qdisc`, `realtek-poe`, `selinux`, `sockstat`, `softnet`, `time`, `timesync`, `ubnt-manager`, `unbound`, `vmstat`, `wifi`, `wireguard` |
| `COLLECTOR_CRASHED` | The collector died with an exception. The detail is the exception's first line. | `conform.uc`, `scrape.uc` |
| `COLLECTOR_NO_RESULT` | The collector returned something other than a Result, or a failure without an error code (a code the collector API does not export is null). The detail says what. | `conform.uc`, `runner.uc`, `scrape.uc` |
| `COLLECTOR_INVALID` | A collector module that cannot be loaded as one (its `meta` or `collect`), which the exporter leaves out; or a query that names a collector that is not installed, or one that is disabled, which is answered 400. | `loader.uc`, `scrape.uc` |

## Configuration

| Code | Meaning | Raised by |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `CONFIG_INVALID` | An option has a value the exporter does not take, or options that go together are not set together. The detail is `<option>: expected <what>, got <value>` (never the value of `auth_password`), or what is missing. | `auth.uc`, `config.uc`, `config/types.uc`, `conform.uc`; the collectors `diskstats`, `netstat`, `snmp6`, `vmstat` |
| `FILE_UNWRITABLE` | The init script could not write or remove uhttpd's basic auth file, `/var/run/prometheus-exporter/uhttpd.conf`; or the ubus object's `set_password` could not write the hash's config, `/etc/config/prometheus-exporter-auth`. | `auth.uc`, `rpc.uc` |

## Capabilities

| Code | Meaning | Raised by |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `NEED_MISSING` | A capability the collector needs is not installed: `nl80211` without ucode-mod-nl80211, `socket` without ucode-mod-socket. | `deps.uc` |
| `UBUS_CONNECT_FAILED` | The exporter could not connect to ubus. | `deps/ubus.uc` |
| `UBUS_CALL_FAILED` | A ubus call failed. The detail is `<object> <method>: <status>`, as `Not found`. | `deps/ubus.uc`, `services.uc` |
| `NL80211_FAILED` | An nl80211 request failed. The detail is the device and the kernel's error. | `deps/netlink.uc` |
| `RTNL_FAILED` | An rtnetlink request failed. The detail is the kernel's error. | `deps/netlink.uc` |
| `SOCKET_FAILED` | A Unix socket is missing, refused the connection, or sent no more of its reply in time. The detail names the socket. | `deps/socket.uc` |
| `COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED` | The collector ran a program its `meta.commands` does not list. | `conform.uc`, `deps/exec.uc` |
| `COMMAND_FAILED` | A program could not start or exited with a status other than 0. The detail is `<program>: exit status <n>` or `<program>: cannot start`. | `deps/exec.uc` |
| `COMMAND_TIMEOUT` | A program was still running when the collector's seconds for programs were spent, and was killed with every process it started; or the collector asked to run one after they were spent. | `deps/exec.uc`, `ledger.uc` |

## The scrape

| Code | Meaning | Raised by |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `SCRAPE_DEADLINE` | The scrape's time was nearly spent: the collector was not run, or a program it ran was killed at the deadline, so that the scrape answers before the scraper gives up. The scrape logs every such collector in one line. See [About deadlines and circuit breakers](../explanation/deadlines-and-breakers.md). | `conform.uc`, `deps/exec.uc`, `ledger.uc`, `runner.uc`, `scrape.uc` |
| `COLLECTOR_QUARANTINED` | The collector's circuit breaker is open: it was not run in this scrape, even if the query named it. The detail says what tripped the breaker and when the collector is tried again; a restart of the service tries it at once. | `ledger.uc` |
| `COLLECTOR_OVERRUN` | What tripped a breaker: the collector took longer than its `budget`. The detail is how long it took and its budget. The run itself counts as it went; its breaker trips. | `ledger.uc` |

## What the exporter enforces of a collector

| Code | Meaning | Raised by |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `COLLECTOR_CANCELLED` | The collector was still running at the end of its `budget`, and was stopped with the process it ran in: a loop that never ends, or a system call that never returns. None of its samples are served, and its breaker trips. See [Collector contract](collector-contract.md). | `conform.uc`, `ledger.uc`, `runner.uc` |
| `COLLECTOR_KILLED` | The process the collector ran in ended while it ran: it went past the memory limit, a native module crashed, or it called `exit()`; or the scrape process itself died while it ran, which the next scrape finds. None of its samples are served, and its breaker trips. | `conform.uc`, `ledger.uc`, `runner.uc` |
| `COLLECTOR_NOT_RUN` | The collector was not run: the processes the scrape forked to run the collectors in ended twice in a row before they ran one, logged once for all of them. Not the collector's doing: its breaker is as it was. | `runner.uc` |
| `SAMPLE_LIMIT` | The collector wrote more samples than its `max_samples`, and was stopped there; or more than were left of the reply's `max_scrape_samples`, or none were left when it would have started, which leaves its breaker as it was. The detail says how many and in which family. None of its samples are served. | `conform.uc`, `ledger.uc`, `scrape.uc` |
| `FAMILY_CONFLICT` | The collector wrote a family that another collector of the reply wrote first, or one the exporter keeps for itself (`node_scrape_collector_*`, `ucode_prometheus_exporter_*`). The detail names it. None of its samples are served. | `conform.uc`, `ownership.uc` |

## Exposition text

| Code | Meaning | Raised by |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `EXPOSITION_INVALID` | Text that is not valid Prometheus exposition format: a `*.prom` file of textfile, which the collector then leaves out, and the detail names the line; or what a collector wrote that Prometheus would refuse the whole scrape for, a label value or HELP text that is not valid UTF-8, two label names that are one once sanitized (`if-name` and `if_name`), or labels that are neither an object nor what `out.labels()` made. The recorder stops the collector there, and the detail names the family and the label. None of its samples are served. | `exposition/parse.uc`, `scrape.uc` |
